product.title: Arts District E Bike Tour
product.description: Guided e-bike tour through central Las Vegas featuring the 18b Arts District, murals, and iconic city landmarks.
highlights: Discover the 18b Arts District and local Las Vegas culture on a guided e-bike ride.
Ride with a personal tour guide and included safety gear.
Visit major Las Vegas landmarks including The STRAT, Gold & Silver Pawn Shop, and Gateway Arches.
Private activity format with return to the original meeting point.
inclusions: Transportation to & from the meeting point

redemption.description: Please meet your tour guide in the rideshare pickup area. He or she will have e-bikes present with them as well.
